profile.name: Samir Joshi
bio: Java Backend Developer with hands-on experience building production-grade REST APIs and a microservices-based ERP system using Spring Boot, Kafka, and MySQL.
Focused on writing clean, maintainable code and designing event-driven, scalable backend architecture that holds up under real-world load.
Also spent a year teaching Core/Advanced Java at the university level, which sharpened how clearly I can explain and document technical decisions.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
experience.description: Leading full-stack development of customer-facing web applications serving thousands of users. Responsible for architecture decisions, code reviews, and mentoring junior developers while delivering high-quality features on tight deadlines.
bullets: Developed and maintained full-stack web applications using React and Node.js.
Built 15+ RESTful APIs and integrated third-party services for enhanced functionality.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement new features.
Improved application performance by 40% through code optimization and Redis caching.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines reducing deployment time from 2 hours to 15 minutes.
Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests achieving 90%+ code coverage.
achievements: 40% faster API response times via caching

experience.title: Web Developer Intern
experience.description: Contributed to client projects building responsive, pixel-perfect websites. Worked closely with designers and senior developers to translate Figma designs into production-ready React components.
bullets: Built responsive client websites using React, JavaScript, and CSS.
Implemented pixel-perfect designs across different devices and browsers.
Gained experience with Git workflows and collaborative development.
Delivered 5+ client projects on time with positive feedback.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A production-ready full-stack e-commerce platform with a complete shopping experience — product catalog, cart management, user authentication, and Stripe payment processing. Built with a focus on performance, security, and scalability to handle real-world traffic.
bullets: React frontend with Tailwind CSS, responsive design, and optimized Core Web Vitals.
Node.js/Express backend with JWT authentication and role-based access control.
MongoDB for data persistence with indexed queries for fast product search.
Stripe payment gateway integration with webhook handling for order fulfillment.
Redis caching layer reducing database load by 60% on high-traffic endpoints.
Deployed on AWS EC2 with Nginx reverse proxy and SSL termination.

projects.title: Task Management App
projects.description: A real-time collaborative task management application inspired by Trello. Teams can create boards, manage tasks with drag-and-drop, assign members, set deadlines, and see live updates — all without refreshing the page.
bullets: React DnD for intuitive drag-and-drop task organization across columns.
WebSocket (Socket.io) for real-time collaboration — changes sync instantly.
JWT-based authentication with refresh token rotation for security.
PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for reliable relational data storage.
Email notifications via SendGrid for task assignments and deadlines.
Mobile-responsive design with offline support via service workers.

projects.title: Weather Dashboard
projects.description: An interactive weather dashboard providing real-time conditions and 7-day forecasts for any city worldwide. Features beautiful data visualizations, location detection, and a polished UI with dark/light mode support.
bullets: OpenWeatherMap API integration with error handling and loading states.
Chart.js for interactive temperature, humidity, and precipitation charts.
Geolocation API for automatic current location detection.
Responsive design with smooth dark/light mode toggle.
API response caching with localStorage to reduce rate limiting.
Search history with recent cities stored in browser storage.
